about.title: About Read TES
about.intro: Read TES is an independent, interactive reading of Talmud Eser Sefirot — Baal HaSulam's foundational commentary on the Kabbalah of the Ari — built by students of Bnei Baruch Kabbalah Academy for anyone studying the text closely, in Hebrew or in English.
about.readingModelBody: The reader follows the structure of Talmud Eser Sefirot itself: the Ari's numbered text, Baal HaSulam's Inner Light explanation anchored directly to it, and Inner Observation as the deeper systematic explanation for the part. Inner Observation is continuous rather than paragraph-linked, so it remains an independent reading pane.
